algorithm: CA-BOSS v4.58 joint local-context-stratified stability rescue

v456_joint_sliced_geometry_diagnostic.interpretation: joint sliced-distribution geometry carried signal, but neither the raw nor copula route was precision-safe and their intersection added nothing

v457_global_null_stability_diagnostic.interpretation: a global maximum null was nearly or fully stable in every target fit, so global threshold relaxation was rejected

v458_context_stratified_stability.interpretation: calibration restricted to the same observable three-of-three local mutual-nearest context stratum separates 25 stable joint-geometry proposals from the global catastrophic nulls

method_contract.proposal_source: nominal v4.57 raw joint four-feature rank-product proposals new relative to the target-safe v4.55 union
joint_geometry_signals: joint sliced-distribution global component coassignment count
negative maximum normalized joint sliced reporter cost
mean joint sliced global exclusion margin
method_contract.target_candidate_bootstrap: 100 whole-world resamples under the frozen v4.57 raw joint geometry rule
method_contract.context_stratum: strict local mutual-nearest reporter agreement in the full fit and both disjoint held-out-background-feature folds
method_contract.null_reference: maximum selection count among every labelled null assay pair in four non-target blocks that also occupies the three-of-three local-consensus stratum
method_contract.null_count_estimation: each candidate calibration block is scored in three folds whose null labels exclude both the target and candidate blocks
method_contract.empirical_null_gate: target selection count strictly exceeds the worst same-stratum non-target null count
method_contract.uncertainty_gate: working Beta(1,1) probability that the target selection probability exceeds the same-stratum worst-null probability is at least 0.975
method_contract.uncertainty_caveat: bootstrap refits are dependent and are not treated as independent Bernoulli trials; the Beta comparison is a conservative working score, not a calibrated posterior
method_contract.conflict_handling: merge connected assay pairs into one unexpanded ambiguity hyperedge
method_contract.claim_scope: shared-state equivalence only; never within-assay direct structure, exact cross-assay feature identity, or direction

context_stratum_audit.retrospective_stratum_choice_interpretat: the three-of-three stratum was selected after truth-separated inspection of the cached diagnostic proposals; it is a development result requiring future locked confirmation, not an independently certified rule

published_method_inspiration.unpaired_multi_domain_causal_representat: Sturma, Squires, Drton, and Uhler (NeurIPS 2023), Unpaired Multi-Domain Causal Representation Learning, DOI 10.52202/075280-1496
published_method_inspiration.mmd_ma: Liu, Huang, Singh, Vert, and Noble (WABI 2019), Jointly Embedding Multiple Single-Cell Omics Measurements, DOI 10.4230/LIPIcs.WABI.2019.10
published_method_inspiration.scot: Demetci, Santorella, Sandstede, Noble, and Singh (Journal of Computational Biology 2022), SCOT: Single-Cell Multi-Omics Alignment with Optimal Transport, DOI 10.1089/cmb.2021.0446
published_method_inspiration.sliced_wasserstein: Yi and Liu (PMLR 2023), Sliced Wasserstein Variational Inference, https://proceedings.mlr.press/v189/yi23a.html
published_method_inspiration.stability_selection: Meinshausen and Buehlmann (JRSS B 2010), Stability Selection, DOI 10.1111/j.1467-9868.2010.00740.x
published_method_inspiration.relationship: V4.58 adapts distributional latent-component matching, multi-view agreement, and empirical-null stability calibration. No publication contributes data, correspondence, modality identity, feature identity, biological priors, or an identifiability guarantee for this simulator.

limitations.interpretation: V4.58 is the strongest conservative cached-world checkpoint, but all 103 worlds and truth-separated diagnostics informed method development. Its 1.0 retrospective precision does not establish out-of-sample completeness or identify direct cross-assay effects from disjoint cells.
